about: Hand-entered facts of the Oort Cloud info card (the population numbers come from model.json).

rows.label: Extent
rows.source: Inner edge: Hills (1981, AJ 86, 1730) and the detached orbits of sednoids; outer edge: Oort (1950), Duncan, Quinn & Tremaine (1987, AJ 94, 1330), where the Galactic tide and passing stars strip comets from the Sun

rows.label: Predicted by
rows.source: Öpik (1932, Proc. Am. Acad. Arts Sci. 67, 169); Oort (1950, Bull. Astron. Inst. Netherlands 11, 91)

rows.label: Observed
rows.value: never directly: its comets are far too small and dark; it is inferred from the orbits of long-period comets
rows.source: Oort (1950); Dones et al. (2015, Space Sci. Rev. 197, 191)
